AddConversationRequest.description:
Distill a multi-turn conversation into atomic facts and store each one, applying
the same intent classification, deduplication, and background entity extraction
as bulk/create. On empty extraction, nothing is stored.

is_agent_memory.description: When true, extract facts about the assistant instead of the user. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Optional session id to group these facts under (existing :CONTAINS session path).

tags.description: Tags for scoped retrieval, applied to every stored fact.

transcript_path.description:
Optional producer-local transcript file path (pointer anchor, binds from
"transcript_path"). Stored verbatim as the transcript_path attribute on every
fact extracted from this conversation.

user_id.description: User identifier who owns the extracted memories.

code.description: Short error code for client-side handling (e.g., "not_found", "validation_error", "internal_error").

detail.description: Optional detailed information (stack trace in development, null in production).

ConversationIngestItem.description: One fact distilled from a conversation and stored.

error.description: Failure detail when `event` is `ERROR` (or another failed branch); absent otherwise.

event.description: What the store pipeline did, e.g. `ADD`, `SKIP_DUPLICATE`, or `ERROR`.

id.description: Id of the stored memory. Empty when the underlying pipeline event carries no id (e.g. `ERROR`, `INVALIDATE`).

ConversationIngestResponse.description:
Result of ingesting a conversation. The two members are mutually exclusive on the
wire (matches the pre-existing untyped response, which sent one key or the other,
never both): omit `no_facts_extracted` when facts were stored, omit
`results` when nothing was extracted. Both are nullable so the server's
global `DefaultIgnoreCondition = WhenWritingNull` drops the unset one instead of
serializing it as `[]` / `false` alongside the other.

no_facts_extracted.description: True when the conversation yielded no storable facts; absent otherwise.

results.description: One entry per distilled fact. Absent when nothing was extracted.

ConversationMessageItem.description: Single turn in a conversation passed to `AddConversationRequest`.

uuid.description:
Optional producer-side turn uuid (pointer anchor, binds from "uuid"). When
present, facts extracted from this turn carry it in source_turn_uuids.

app.description: Optional application name creating the memory.

memory_type.description:
Optional caller-provided cognitive type (episodic|semantic|
            procedural). Invalid/blank values are ignored and the server falls back to
            auto-classification.

user_id.description: User identifier who owns this memory.

memory_ids.description: List of memory IDs to delete.

error.description: Error message if the check failed.

ok.description: Whether the embedding provider is operational.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the health check was performed.

status.description: Overall status: `ok` when every check passed, `degraded` otherwise.

IndexesCheck.description: Vector-index status from the startup embedding-guard report (informational — never fails health).

error.description: Introspection error captured at startup, if any.

mismatches.description: Dimension mismatches as "Label.property: index N != provider M" strings.

ok.description: Whether all vector indexes match the provider dimension and introspection succeeded.

error.description: Error message if the check failed.

ok.description: Whether the database is reachable and responding.

user.description: Database user used for the connection.

MemoryCreatedResponse.description: Response returned after creating a memory.

app_name.description: Application name that created this memory.

content.description: Text content of the created memory.

id.description: Unique identifier of the created memory.

invalid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which this memory was invalidated/superseded.

is_current.description: Whether this is the current (non-superseded) version of the memory.

is_global.description:
True when this is a globally-shared memory owned by another user
            (surfaced via global scope). Lets the UI badge it as shared/global.

superseded_by.description: Identifier of the newer memory that superseded this one.

valid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from which this memory version is valid.

MemoryListItemResponse.description: Memory item in a list/filter/search response.

invalid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which this memory was invalidated/superseded.

is_current.description: Whether this is the current (non-superseded) version of the memory.

is_global.description:
True when this is a globally-shared memory owned by another user
            (surfaced via global scope). Lets the UI badge it as shared/global.

memory_type.description:
Cognitive type: episodic|semantic|procedural (coalesced to
            'semantic' for legacy/untyped rows).

valid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from which this memory version is valid.

MemoryListPagedResponse.description: Paginated list of memory list items.

items.description: Memory items on the current page.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

expand_query.description: When true, expands query with LLM-generated synonyms before text search.

include_faded.description:
When true, include faded/stale memories that are normally hidden from search
results (bypasses the opt-in hard-fade filter). Default false. Has no effect
unless the server has fading enabled.

include_session_arm.description:
When true, also vector-searches session summaries and expands top matches
to their member memories. Useful when memories are fine-grained (per-turn,
per-dialog) and the right episode is buried in many candidates.

memory_type.description:
Optional filter restricting results to a cognitive type
            (episodic|semantic|procedural). Invalid/blank values are ignored (no filter).

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid, text, or vector.

rerank.description: Rerank strategy: "cross_encoder" for LLM-based reranking, or null/empty to skip.

session_id.description: Optional session ID to restrict results to a specific session.

token_budget.description:
Optional ceiling on the estimated token size of the returned results. 0
(default) means unbounded, though the server may still apply its own
configured default budget in that case. A positive value trims the ranked
result list to fit within N estimated tokens (lowest-ranked results dropped
first; order is never changed), costed against whichever field the response's
detail tier returns.
